description: September 9 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 9 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: September 9 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Picture a meticulous volunteer coordinator and you have one interpretive sketch of September 9. The Sun at sixteen degrees of Virgo carries Saturn's sense of duty from the second decan, and the birthday number 9, linked with compassion and completion, widens the circle of concern. Details still matter here, but mostly because they help other people, not because they impress.

On September 9 the Sun usually sits at about 16° Virgo, in the second decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: September 9 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one September 9 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on September 9: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 9 is the 252nd day of the year (253rd in a leap year). By September 23, 14 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 9, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on September 9 include Leo Tolstoy (1828), Lila Downs (1968) and Luka Modrić (1985).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 9?
faq.answer: September 9 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 9 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 9?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 9 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 9?
faq.answer: September 9 is also the birthday of Leo Tolstoy (1828), Lila Downs (1968) and Luka Modrić (1985). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
